nodes.label: Signup Page (standalone, role + plan selection)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately standalone (does NOT extend base.html) with its own Tailwind CDN, AOS, dark-mode localStorage ('py-theme') and ripple code, so unauthenticated users get a self-contained page.

nodes.label: Teacher Verification Flow (NID + qualification upload, manual review)
nodes.rationale: Choosing the Teacher (ADMIN) role reveals required subject expertise, bio, NID photo and qualification certificate fields; accounts are reviewed before activation to keep content-management privileges away from unverified users.

edges.source_location: same plan codes FREE/BASIC/PREMIUM and prices Tk 0/99/199 in signup plan-group radios
